MUSIC AND DANCE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #1
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MUSIC AND DANCE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Instrumental Transpositions: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Instrumental Transpositions.
   B. Practise Instrumental Transpositions with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Instrumental Transpositions.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Instrumental Transpositions.

2. Best practice when working on Contemporary Dances from the Rest of the World: (1 mark)

   D. Refuse all feedback on Contemporary Dances from the Rest of the World.

5. Best practice when working on Kenyan Contemporary Songs: (1 mark)

6. Best practice when working on Dance Production: (1 mark)

   B. Refuse all feedback on Dance Production.

7. Best practice when working on Four-Part Harmony: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Four-Part Harmony with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Four-Part Harmony.
   C. Damage equipment used for Four-Part Harmony.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Four-Part Harmony.

8. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The speed of the music
   B. Only the volume
   C. Only the costume
   D. The ticket price

9. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Guarantee a trophy
   D. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

10. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Red, blue, and yellow
   B. Green, orange, and purple
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Brown, pink, and gold

11. Best practice when working on Music Notation Software.: (1 mark)

   C. Refuse all feedback on Music Notation Software..

12. Best practice when working on Contemporary Songs from Kenya: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Contemporary Songs from Kenya.
   B. Practise Contemporary Songs from Kenya with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Contemporary Songs from Kenya.
   D. Damage equipment used for Contemporary Songs from Kenya.

13. Best practice when working on Western Ensembles: (1 mark)

   B. Damage equipment used for Western Ensembles.

   D. Disrupt classmates during Western Ensembles.

14. Best practice when working on Setting Text to Music: (1 mark)

15. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
